comment:overrides: undici arrives only through miniflare, which pins it EXACTLY (7.28.0), so npm cannot move it and dependabot cannot either. 7.29.0 closes five advisories in that pin: cross-user cache disclosure + parse crash on degenerate private cache directives (high), the whitespace-around-equals variant of the same, cookie attribute injection via unsanitized domain, response desync in the retry interceptor, and CRLF injection via a blob-like body type. Same major miniflare was built against, so it is a patch bump rather than a runtime gamble. Drop this the day miniflare pins >= 7.29.0 itself.
